config.name: Sintel geometry pipeline pilot; not training-ready or final test
config.selection_rule: Before model outputs: source families ordered by SHA256(20261022:family); first sequence lexically in each family with frames1..25 in all three modalities; first6 families, first4 pilot_train/last2 pilot_dev.
config.render_pass: clean only; no albedo/final duplicate views in another split
config.validity_policy: Finite positive depth is only numeric validity, not transparency/occlusion/boundary reliability. No official depth-confidence mask assumed. Raw GT retained, no guessed far-plane cutoff.
config.geometry_policy: Native meter depth and inverse meters only; preserve camera projection x=K[R|t]X. No VDA normalization, alignment, focus/K, GT target region, perturbation, or bokeh generation yet.
config.evaluation_scope: Pilot scene-family disjointness only; same movie/assets across scenes possible. VDA literature already uses Sintel for evaluation; foundation model training exposure not audited. Not zero-shot or independent final benchmark.
config.spring_status: Official sample HTTP request timed out during initial check; no full Spring data downloaded. Remains candidate.
